## APPROACH 

For this assignment, I will work with information about three books related to real estate: **The Book on Rental Property Investing,** **The Millionaire Real Estate Investor**, and **The****Complete Idiot’s Guide to Buying a Home**. For each book, I will use its title, author or authors, publication year, publisher, and ISBN.

## DATA SOURCE

I manually organized the book information in two files: an HTML file named `Books.html`, which contains a table, and a JSON file named `Books.json`, which contains the same information as a list of book records. The files are available in my public GitHub repository.

GitHub Repository - <https://github.com/MrKpoku/Data-Acquistion-and-Mangement---Kingsley-Kojo-Kpoku/tree/main/HTML%20and%20JSON>

## PLANNED APPROACH

1.  **Inspect the files** — review the HTML table and JSON structure to understand how the book information is organized.

2.  **Load the HTML data** — use the `rvest` package in R to read the table into a data frame.

3.  **Load the JSON data** — use the `jsonlite` package in R to read the book records into a separate data frame.

4.  **Standardize the data** — make column names, title capitalization, and data types consistent so that R can compare the two data frames fairly.

5.  **Compare the data** — use R to check whether both data frames contain the same book information.

6.  **Present the process** — include the R code and its output in a Quarto report.

***The results of the comparison and any findings will be discussed later in my code base analysis.***
